method.deduplication: First isolate per subject per organism per period (CLSI M39). Kept 21 of 22 isolates between 2024-03-19 and 2026-07-08 (4.5% removed as repeats) across 19 subject(s). 1 of them (4.5%) carried no subject identifier and were kept as distinct, since repeat sampling cannot be detected without one.
